metadata.title: Data Classification

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for assigning sensitivity, criticality, and protection obligations to data based on institutional risk and policy.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Data governance frameworks, classification taxonomies, metadata systems, and policy-driven protection mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Constraint pattern defining how data sensitivity and criticality drive mandatory handling, protection, and retention requirements.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Data classification refines meaning and obligation for data governed under Data Core.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Data classification aligns with NIST SP 800-60 guidance for security categorization of information types.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Classification informs risk assessment, planning, and control selection.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Classification supports privacy risk identification, minimization, and appropriate data handling.

metadata.remarks: Data Classification defines how data is categorized according to sensitivity, criticality, and legal or ethical obligation. This pattern establishes classification as a binding decision that drives protection, handling, sharing, and retention requirements across the Secure Data architecture.

components.title: Data Sensitivity Determination
components.description: Determines the sensitivity level of data based on confidentiality, integrity, and availability impact.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exfiltration or exposure of sensitive data due to misclassification or absence of sensitivity labeling.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Data labeling and sensitivity tagging enable appropriate protection enforcement.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Information sensitivity and criticality are defined and documented.
Risk assessments incorporate data sensitivity considerations.

components.title: Classification Binding and Enforcement
components.description: Binds classification decisions to mandatory handling, protection, and access requirements.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Disabling or bypassing classification-aware protections to access restricted data.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy-driven enforcement ensures classification dictates protections.

components.title: Classification Consistency and Review
components.description: Ensures data classifications remain accurate and are periodically reviewed as data context evolves.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Data destruction or loss due to incorrect or outdated classification.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Governance review processes maintain classification accuracy.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Classification policies and decisions are reviewed and updated.
